projectCopilot.organizeTaskPrompt: Organize the Task attached to this instruction by creating suitable WorkUnits with clear outcomes. If one WorkUnit is sufficient for this small Task, create one instead of splitting it unnecessarily. Preserve the Task requirements. Use only existing TaskRoles and eligible Project memberships. If role setup is incomplete or no suitable member is eligible, explain what is missing instead of inventing roles or assignments. Create and allocate WorkUnits only. Do not start or execute workers. Summarize what you created and any blockers.

projectPlan.title: Project plan
projectPlan.description: Inspect task dependencies, readiness, estimates, and authorized delivery batches.
projectPlan.loadFailed: Project plan could not be loaded.
projectPlan.optionalTitle: The project dependency plan is optional
projectPlan.optionalDescription: Tasks can still be created and managed independently. Copilot can suggest a plan from ordinary text or project material, but an empty plan never blocks manual work.
projectPlan.copilotHint: Use the Copilot button at the bottom right to describe the work in your own words. Opening Copilot here keeps it at Project scope; it sends no message and starts no model turn until you send one.
projectPlan.proposalsHint: Inspect the proposed Tasks, links, estimates, and sources before applying a revision.
projectPlan.noProposals: No project plan proposals yet. Ask Copilot in free-form text if a dependency plan would help.
projectPlan.staleProposal: This proposal is based on an older graph version. Refresh or ask Copilot for an updated proposal before applying it.
projectPlan.incompleteApplyRetryHint: A previous apply left a staged Task that is blocked from work. Retry reuses the original graph version and idempotency key; it resumes only if the graph is still at that version. If another change advanced the graph, refresh and review the proposal after the version conflict.
projectPlan.applyExplanation: Applying records this revision and creates or maps Tasks. It does not authorize execution.
projectPlan.writerRequiredApply: A Project owner, admin, or member can apply a proposal.
projectPlan.proposalNoDependencies: This proposal contains no dependency links.
projectPlan.graphHint: Cards are Tasks (work packets); WorkUnit dependencies stay inside each Task.
projectPlan.emptyTitle: No project Tasks are in this graph yet
projectPlan.emptyDescription: A project DAG is optional. Create or manage independent Tasks from the Tasks page; no dependency plan is required.
projectPlan.structuralWidthHint: Ideal DAG level width. It excludes authorization, worker capacity, review, and integration.
projectPlan.tasksExecutingDetail: Observed now; this is actual work, not the graph's potential width.
projectPlan.idealEstimateOnly: Estimated from Task intervals only; not an ETA.
projectPlan.incompleteEstimateHint: Unknown if any Task estimate is missing or invalid; unknown is not zero.
projectPlan.authorizeHint: An owner or admin can authorize a selected set or the visible phase. The scheduler admits eligible Tasks automatically when their exact coordinator setup and prerequisites are ready.
projectPlan.blockedTasksIncluded: Backlog, ready, and lifecycle-blocked Tasks can be authorized together, including Tasks blocked by prerequisites; the scheduler waits for accepted handoffs. Active, merging, ready-to-merge, done, and cancelled Tasks cannot be replanned here.
projectPlan.batchNotSelectable: This TaskLifecycle state is not eligible for project batch authorization.
projectPlan.workUnitSlotsSeparate: This limit applies to Tasks. WorkUnit slots inside each Task are separate.
projectPlan.adminOnlyAuthorize: Only a Project owner or admin can authorize a phase or Task batch.
projectPlan.configureCoordination: Review Project team and coordination defaults
projectPlan.noDependencies: No Task dependencies are recorded. Tasks remain independent.
projectPlan.noPhaseTasks: No Tasks match this phase filter.
projectPlan.batchesHint: Batch authority advances ready Tasks automatically; it does not bypass review, Gates, integration, or WorkUnit admission.
projectPlan.noBatches: No Task batch has been authorized.
projectPlan.adminOnlyBatch: Only a Project owner or admin can change batch authority.
